en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from a grassy hill overlooking a historic European town. In the foreground is a sloping lawn, then dense trees and traditional gabled houses with steep roofs. Dominating the background is a large hilltop castle complex with high walls, towers, and multi‑wing buildings, alongside a prominent church with a tall clock tower and baroque-style dome. Fields and low hills stretch into the distance.
